newsitem.title: BELGIUM: D'IETEREN EXPECTS FURTHER PROFIT GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: D'IETEREN EXPECTS FURTHER PROFIT GROWTH.

text.p: Belgian car importer and distributor D'Ieteren NV said on Thursday it expected its profit to rise further in 1997 due to the growth potential of imports and of its Avis Europe subsidiary.

"We're expecting further profit growth for 1997 due to a very good profit capacity of our import activities and the strong growth potential of Avis Europe," chief financial officer Jacques de Smet told a news conference on 1996 results.
D'Ieteren's 1996 group net profit more than tripled to 1.62 billion Belgian francs.
